name: Piyush Tatrari
summary: Full Stack Engineer with **2+ years** building **Generative AI** products at CustomerInsights.AI. Owns core use cases of **ciATHENA**, an AI agent platform for pharma commercial teams, from **React.js/TypeScript** screens to **Python/FastAPI** services for **6+** **pharma clients**, including **LangGraph** agents with human approval and **RAG** on **Azure OpenAI**. Co-designed a configuration-driven backend that cut new-client onboarding effort by about **50%**. Promoted to Associate Full Stack Engineer in April 2026; two-time **Employee of the Quarter** (Sep 2025, Sep 2026).

experience.title: Associate Full Stack Engineer
experience.lead: Full-stack owner of ciATHENA's pharma use cases in a 20+ member team. Employee of the Quarter, September 2026.
points: Own **4+ core use cases** of ciATHENA (MMM, FAST, Payer Spine, Data Stewardship) end to end, from **React.js** and **TypeScript** screens to **FastAPI** services, for **6+ pharma clients**, each with client-specific data and features.
Built the Field Intelligence backend and **3+ AI agents** in **LangChain** and **LangGraph**, with configuration screens, an execution service and a human approval step before every agent action.
Implemented production **RAG** on **Azure OpenAI** with embeddings and **Chroma** semantic search, so business users ask plain-language questions and get answers from their own client data.
Cut new-client onboarding effort by about **50%** by co-designing a configuration-driven backend: a new client or use case now needs setup, not a rebuild.
Shipped **50+ FastAPI endpoints** as **Docker** services on **Azure** with **CI/CD** in **GitHub Actions**; results stream to the UI over **Server-Sent Events**.
Maintained **PostgreSQL** and **Snowflake** backends for 3 data workflows: schema and entity review, mapping and batch approvals.
Delivered 3 collaboration modules (ongoing threads, team collaboration, insights hub) with **ECharts** and **Zustand**.
